review.subtitle: Hamilton Khaki Field Auto 38 mm, black dial with date, black leather strap
notes: Front reference is Hamilton's official straight-on product render (2100 x 2054 px, from the Bucherer listing); the photo you supplied is the 3/4 view.

Brushed case flank and lugs, the wide polished bezel, the polished crown and date frame are modelled; the pencil hour and minute hands with lume and thin points, the white seconds hand with its red tip and small counterweight are modelled too. The dial print and the leather come from the render.
Heights are estimated from the official 11 mm (no side photo).
